items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High in the mid Atlantic, low pressure near Iceland with a cold front crossing the Irish Sea this morning.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, increasing 5 to 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain at first, then isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 6 or 7, decreasing north-northwest 5 or 6 overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate occasionally rough becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, heavy at times.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.
